question: Which key can be pressed to initiate a slide show in MS PowerPoint?
solution:
The correct answer is __Function key F5__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• F5 is the standard keyboard shortcut to start a slide show from the beginning in Microsoft PowerPoint.
 
• When you press F5, PowerPoint begins the presentation from the first slide, advancing to the next slide automatically or manually based on your settings.
 
• This shortcut is designed to be intuitive and efficient, allowing you to quickly start and navigate your presentation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ 

 
• F2: This key is used to rename the currently selected file or folder.
 
• F4: In PowerPoint, F4 repeats the last action that was performed.
 
• F8: This key is used to activate the extended selection mode, allowing you to select multiple non-adjacent objects.
